summary: Frontend-only test of web_panel one-click DEMO LOGIN buttons on https://customer-auth-native.preview.emergentagent.com/login. All 4 demo login buttons (Admin, Partner, Customer, Merchant) work correctly. Each button logs the user in and lands on the correct role dashboard (/admin, /partner, /account, /merchant respectively). NO 'Demo login failed' toast, NO CORS errors, NO 'Failed to fetch' console errors observed on any of the four flows. Same-origin API base (window.location.origin) fallback is working as designed since REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is intentionally empty.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: A few auxiliary endpoints return 4xx or fail: /api/auth/config, /api/auth/demo-status, /api/growth/config, /api/site/config. They do not affect the demo login flow but generate console noise. Consider handling 403/404 gracefully or removing these calls for unauthenticated/public panels.

Non-blocking: Some Pexels image URLs (photos/6195274, 6471913, 17063686, 1094767) return failed requests on the merchant dashboard — hotlink-blocked or replaced. Consider self-hosting or fallback images.
Non-blocking: /api/realtime/stream SSE aborts on navigation (expected browser behavior, but noisy in console).
test_credentials: Preview URL: https://customer-auth-native.preview.emergentagent.com/login — Demo one-click buttons (OTP 123456 available for all). Admin +919000000000, Merchant +919000000002, Partner +919000000003, Customer +919000000004.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The login page is at /login (root / is the landing page). Demo login buttons are labeled 'Login as Admin/Partner/Customer/Merchant' under 'ONE-CLICK DEMO LOGIN - OTP 123456' section. Same-origin API base works fine; no CORS issues. When re-testing multiple roles in one session, use domcontentloaded (not networkidle) and clear localStorage/sessionStorage between roles to avoid auto-redirect to previous role dashboard.
rca of the issue: N/A - No blocking issue. The reported potential CORS/same-origin failure was NOT reproduced. api.js fallback to window.location.origin works correctly, and all demo login POSTs (send-otp + verify-otp) succeed 200 through the same-origin /api proxy.
